title: Storage: saves on a protected main branch, and lists that survive one damaged record
seam: src/main/store/github/, src/main/store/store.ts, and the notice and flagged-item rendering in the project list, map, tickets and PRD view screens under src/renderer/screens/
story: Saving to a project whose GitHub main branch is protected now behaves like a normal save while its pull request waits: numbers don't collide, a session or PRD version saved a moment ago can be updated or scored, and a note above the open screen names the pull request; once dismissed, it stays dismissed. Before, two saves both took S1 and a follow-up update failed with 'not found'. One hand-damaged project, ticket or score file used to empty the whole project list, map, tickets screen or PRD view; now only that item is flagged, with the reason. The tickets screen reads waiting GitHub comments with one store call per project instead of one per ticket.

checks.criterion: When a save becomes a pull request, the member sees a notice naming it on the screen where they saved.
checks.steps: Make a made-up repository whose main branch is protected and open it as a project in Grillo. On the Project screen, invite a made-up login. Press Dismiss, then save another change to the same record (for example the same member's role).
checks.expected: A note above the screen says 'Saved as pull request #N, "grillo: …"', names the repository, and has Open on GitHub and Dismiss. Dismiss removes it and later saves into the same pull request never bring it back; a save that opens a new pull request shows a new note.

checks.criterion: With main protected, two saves in a row get different numbers.
checks.steps: In that project, add two sources one after the other.
checks.expected: S1 and S2, two pull requests on GitHub with different files, and the map's Sources list shows both before anything is merged.

checks.criterion: A damaged project is flagged and the list still shows every other project.
checks.steps: On GitHub, put 'not json' into .grillo/members.json of one made-up project, then open the Project screen.
checks.expected: That project shows 'Damaged' with the reason and 'Fix the file on GitHub…'; the other projects show as usual.

checks.criterion: A damaged ticket is flagged on the map and the tickets screen, and the rest still work.
checks.steps: On GitHub, add a second wayfinder: kind label to one made-up ticket. Open Map, then Tickets, then select that ticket.
checks.expected: The map row shows 'Damaged' with the reason and no Edit, Merge or Close; the tickets list shows a Damaged badge and the card shows a warning note and no controls; every other ticket works as before.

checks.criterion: A damaged score file is flagged and Rerun stays reachable.
checks.steps: On GitHub, replace .grillo/prd/v<latest>.score.json with '{ not json', then open PRD.
checks.expected: The Score panel and the version row show 'Damaged' with the reason; Rerun is enabled and writes a fresh score.
